question: The endangered bird species found in the Thar Desert is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Great Indian Bustard**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Great Indian Bustard** is one of the heaviest flying birds, primarily found in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is critically endangered and has been listed in the **IUCN Red List** due to its rapidly declining population.
 
• The bird is native to arid and semi-arid regions, especially the **Thar Desert** in Rajasthan, which serves as its primary habitat.
 
• Major threats include **habitat loss**, poaching, and collisions with power lines.
 
• Conservation efforts include the **Great Indian Bustard Conservation Program** and the establishment of wildlife sanctuaries like the **Desert National Park**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thar Desert:**

 
 
• The Thar Desert, also known as the Great Indian Desert, is located in northwestern India and eastern Pakistan.
 
• It is characterized by extreme temperatures, low rainfall, and sandy terrain, making it one of the most arid regions in India.
 
 
 
• **Critically Endangered Species:**
 
 
• Species listed as "Critically Endangered" by the **IUCN Red List** face an extremely high risk of extinction in the wild.
 
• Examples include the Great Indian Bustard, Vaquita, and Axolotl.
 
 
 
• **Desert National Park:**
 
 
• Located in Rajasthan, this park is one of the largest wildlife sanctuaries in India and a key habitat for the Great Indian Bustard.
 
• The park also supports other species like desert foxes, eagles, and sand grouse.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Challenges:**
 
 
• The Great Indian Bustard faces threats such as habitat fragmentation, hunting, and infrastructure development.
 
• Innovative solutions like the installation of bird diverters on power lines are being implemented to prevent collisions.
